assessments.reasoning: Section 9.1.1.5.5 creates an initialized immutable binding that retains the module and target name. Section 9.1.1.5.1 resolves an indirect binding by reading the target environment using that name. The target lookup has its own initialization and error conditions.

challenge.method: Trace both algorithms, including an empty environment and an uninitialized target. Use two benign linked test modules to contrast an exporter mutation with attempted assignment to the importer binding.
challenge.results: The importer follows the target on each read and can observe a changed exported value. The local binding resists assignment. The textual trace confirms that target availability and initialization are checked independently of the importer’s initialized state. The local Node.js v24.4.1 diagnostic agreed. Import read updated from 1 to 2 after export changed; import assignment threw.

limitations: Only the exact Module Environment Record methods are in scope. Runtime observation of a pair of modules does not independently prove every graph or host behavior.
